content:
Implementation of Phase 39 (Reviewer Panels, 3.3.0) on branch `phase-39-reviewer-panels` — commit f5051fc (+ a one-line tagteam.yaml gate-command fix). Full suite: 1160 passed, 5 skipped. Gate pre-flight (`tagteam gate check --type impl`): PASS — scope 25 paths since the boundary, plan-doc ok, tests ok (3m45s).

WHAT LANDED (plan sections A–I):
- `tagteam/panel.py` (new): `PanelSpec`/`resolve_panel`/`load_spec` (reviewer headless spec via `get_headless_spec`+`resolve_executable`+`build_argv`; briefs resolved builtin → `.tagteam/panels/lenses/<lens>.md` override → `lenses[].brief`; problems warn+disable); `PANEL_CONTRACT` + `compose_lens_prompt` (brief, contract with the exact verdict path, interjection block, state, gate entry if any, round tail, plan); `verify_verdict` (shape, severities, REQUEST_CHANGES needs blocker/major, APPROVE none, NEED_HUMAN needs `question`, ESCALATE a reason); `run_lens` (`h.run_process` with the reviewer argv, per-lens prompt/log/events/verdict files under `.tagteam/panels/<stem>/`, slot pid update, cancel-turn aware, rogue-write detector = round-log length + state.seq before/after, usage row role=reviewer kind=panel:<lens>, rate-limit frames recorded); `merge` (precedence NEED_HUMAN>ESCALATE>REQUEST_CHANGES>APPROVE over ok lenses; ties + grouping in configured lens order; APPROVE only if all configured lenses ok+approve; any failure with no objection → fallback; failed lenses named "not assessed"); `run_panel` = fresh-state submission (stale/not-ready never dispatch) → peek decided (merged → no dispatch; fallback → dispatch if still pinned) → slot-first (kind=panel) → locked sweep + ONE interjection snapshot (recorded on the row) + `claim_panel` (refused → decided / live-other / attempts-exhausted → forced decided `fallback` + dispatch) → sequential lenses → merge → locked pinned (seq/round/status + round-log length) entry-first (`panel_event`) `cycle.add_round(role=reviewer, action, …, updated_by="<Reviewer> panel", meta={panel_event, panel_id, panel_lenses, panel_interjections})` → finish row (decision, applied_seq) + stamp exactly the snapshot delivered, same lock hold → slot released on every path (finally). `sweep_abandoned_panels` (entry-first reconciliation completes only the row the entry names — `panel_id` — stamping the entry's `panel_interjections`; dead/mismatched runner → abandoned; timeout = lenses×reviewer timeout + grace without a matching slot marker → abandoned; unverifiable kept + reported), `panel_status`, `panel_command` (run|status|list|lenses|preview --lens; --json).
- `cycle.py`: `add_round(..., meta=)` — `ENTRY_RESERVED_KEYS`, `_validate_entry_meta` BEFORE the lock (dict, string keys, no reserved keys, JSON-serialisable, requires explicit non-empty `updated_by`, not for AMEND); with meta the entry gets `updated_by` (the argument) then the meta keys; `meta=None` writes are byte-identical (parity corpus unchanged).
- `db.py`: schema v9 `panels` (+`interjection_ids`, `lenses_json`, `decision`, `applied_seq`; `uq_panels_running` / `uq_panels_decided`); `_claim_satellite(table, …)` shared by `claim_gate` and `claim_panel` — the failure budget counts `error|abandoned` rows only (superseded never; the gate's over-counting fixed as planned); `finish_panel`/`update_panel`/`get_panel`/`panels_for_event`/`decided_panel_for_event`/`panels_for_cycle`/`last_panel`/`running_panels`/`unfinished_panels`; `panels` in NON_FILE_BACKED_TABLES.
- `config.py`: `PANEL_KEYS`, `validate_panel_config` (2–3 unique lens names, briefs non-empty paths, unknown keys), `get_panel_spec`; **also fixed a latent 3.2.0 bug found while testing: PyYAML parses a bare `on:` key as boolean True, so `on: [impl]` in tagteam.yaml was reported as an unknown key for BOTH `gatekeeper` and `panel` — `_norm_on_key` accepts True/`on`/`cycles` for both blocks (documented `cycles:` alias).**
- `watcher.py`: `_maybe_panel` after `_maybe_gate` in `_handle_ready` for turn==reviewer (merged/superseded/stale → no dispatch; deferred/error/not-ready → `_panel_owed_seq` latch; fallback/not-applicable/disabled → ordinary hand-off), the same-seq re-entry honours either latch (gate → panel), spec resolved in `_build_processor` (problems warn+disable), banner line. `headless.py`: `SLOT_KIND_PANEL`. `cli.py`: `panel` dispatch + help. Package data: `tagteam/data/panels/{correctness,scope,verification}.md` + `pyproject.toml` glob. Docs: SKILL (both copies identical: lead "Reviewer panel" note + reviewer step-1 note), README subsection + CLI ref, HTW `#panels` section + files table, roadmap; `pyproject.toml`/`CITATION.cff` → 3.3.0. `tests/fixtures/fake_agent.py`: `panel` mode (per-lens behaviours via FAKE_PANEL_VERDICTS: approve / request-changes / escalate / need-human / need-human-noq / no-file / bad-json / bad-shape / rogue / hang / nonzero / approve-with-blocker).
- Tests: `tests/test_panel.py` (54): config matrix + brief resolution (builtin/override/config/missing) + reviewer-must-validate + phases allowlist; verdict validation; merge matrix incl. precedence, tie order, failed-lens naming, partial-panel fallback; run_panel: all-approve → one entry (`updated_by "Codex panel"` in JSONL, DB mirror, render parity, seq+1 once, cycle approved, usage per lens, files, slot free), grouped REQUEST_CHANGES → lead, ESCALATE/NEED_HUMAN transitions (+ ruling re-arm), fallback dispatches and never approves partially, non-conforming lenses failed (bad-json/bad-shape/no-question/approve-with-blocker), nonzero-with-conforming-verdict = ok, all-failed fallback, rogue lens → superseded (its write stands), mid-panel AMEND → superseded then attempt 2 on the same key, slot busy → deferred no row, not-applicable/stale, error→retry→fallback ([error,error,fallback], no lens run on the third pass, restart from fallback → no new row), abandoned→retry→fallback, repeated supersession ([superseded×3, merged]) never exhausts, manual kind; interjections: snapshot rendered identically to every lens (lead-only note excluded), stamped only on merge, fallback/superseded stamp nothing, crash-after-add_round reconciliation stamps exactly the entry's set and leaves a later note pending; sweep matrix; watcher: merged never dispatches / fallback does (notify, tmux, iterm2), headless merged skips the engine / fallback runs it, latch busy→free in all four modes, gate BOUNCE → no panel & gate PASS → panel in the same tick (entries [SUBMIT, GATE_PASS, APPROVE]; lenses saw the gate report), disabled byte-identical, `_build_processor`; CLI (lenses/preview/status/list/run/json/usage), dispatch, docs + package data, flag-off full cycle. `tests/test_cycle.py::TestAddRoundMeta` (JSONL/DB/readers/briefer input + state updater, meta=None byte-identical, every reserved key + non-string/non-JSON/non-dict → nothing written, meta requires updated_by, AMEND rejected, rulings plain). `tests/test_db.py::TestSchemaV9Panels` (v8→v9, budget counts failed only incl. the aligned gate rule, uq_panels_decided, snapshot/restore).

DOGFOOD (real reviewer CLI): scratch git project with a planted bug (`add` mishandles negatives) and a missing negative-number test; `panel: {enabled: true, lenses: [correctness, verification]}` with real `codex exec` lenses; `tagteam panel run` → both lenses found their axis's problem; merged `PANEL: REQUEST_CHANGES — correctness: REQUEST_CHANGES (1 blocker) | verification: REQUEST_CHANGES (1 blocker)` with the two grouped findings (calc.py:3 abs-branch; test_calc.py:2 missing negative test); state → turn lead, updated_by "Codex panel", seq+1; `panel status` shows both lenses ✓ with summaries; 1m11s wall clock for two lenses.

Deviations from the plan text: none material — `interjection_ids` column and `applied_seq` are as specified; `_claim_satellite` counts `error|abandoned` for both tables; the `on:` YAML-boolean fix is a bug fix outside the plan's list, noted above.
